people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
translations.bsb: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; trembling will seize the leaders of Moab; those who dwell in Canaan will melt away,
translations.kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
translations.asv: Then were the chiefs of Edom dismayed; The mighty men of Moab, trembling taketh hold upon them: All the inhabitants of Canaan are melted away.
